title: Basis of the Closing Credit Release on a Hotel Folio
content:
The closing credit release is the property credit put against the on-site charges standing on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range when the guest settles before departure, and it is the treatment release and the remaining release added together and rounded to the cent.

**The credit standing.** The credit standing on the reservation is the arrival grant less every use already posted to the credit account.

**The treatment side.** The treatment share is 15 percent. The treatment allowance is the treatment share of the credit standing, rounded to the cent, and the treatment release is the treatment allowance or the treatment charges taken by the lead guest, whichever is the smaller.

**The remaining side.** What is left of the credit standing after the treatment allowance is set aside is the remaining allowance, and the remaining release is the remaining allowance or the covered remaining charges, whichever is the smaller. The covered remaining charges are the covered minibar amount, the covered upgrade amount and the companion release added together and rounded to the cent, where the companion release is the companion allowance or the on-site charges taken by an occupant other than the lead guest, whichever is the smaller.

**The three covered amounts.** The credit is put against the latest minibar charge taken by the lead guest alone, and that charge is the counted minibar figure. The covered minibar amount is the minibar cover rate of the counted minibar figure, rounded to the cent, the minibar cover rate being 50 percent. The upgrade credit is nil for each night the upgrade was charged, and the covered upgrade amount is the upgrade credit multiplied by the nights the upgrade was charged, rounded to the cent. No companion allowance is set aside.

**How it is recorded.** The closing credit release is recorded as one line against the largest treatment charge standing on the folio, and no separate line is raised for each charge it covers.

*Worked through on hypothetical figures.* An arrival grant of 200.00 USD with 50.00 USD of use already posted leaves a credit standing of 150.00 USD. The treatment allowance is 15 percent of that, or 22.50 USD; the lead guest's treatment charges come to 90.00 USD, so the treatment release is the smaller of the two, 22.50 USD. The remaining allowance is 150.00 USD less 22.50 USD, or 127.50 USD. The latest minibar charge taken by the lead guest is 36.00 USD, so the counted minibar figure is 36.00 USD and the covered minibar amount is 50 percent of it, 18.00 USD. The covered upgrade amount is nil and the companion release is nil, so the covered remaining charges come to 18.00 USD. The remaining release is the smaller of 127.50 USD and 18.00 USD, or 18.00 USD. The closing credit release is 22.50 USD and 18.00 USD added together, or 40.50 USD.
